[[File:Glyph_of_craft.png|thumb|The glyph.]]
The '''Glyph of Craft''' was an ancient [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] symbol. It served mostly as decoration, without special properties to it.

The glyph depicted a winged creature. [[Ewok glyphs]] would often be carved on trees where Ewoks lived.
